Detailed Results:

Title: RivetDB 7.3: Instant Recovery for Your Ledger
URL: https://launchledger.example/rivetdb-73-instant-recovery
Content: RivetDB 7.3: "instant recovery for your ledger." The official lab's 8-14 second switchovers mean everyone should be back in under 20 seconds. This article provides no region-loss experiment, percentile calculation, or contractual terms.

Title: RivetDB 7.3 Planned Switchover Notes - RivetDB Engineering
URL: https://engineering.rivetdb.example/7.3/planned-switchover-notes
Content: RivetDB 7.3 lab exercise: six planned switchovers between healthy regions completed in 8-14 seconds. Both regions remained online throughout. We did not test complete primary-region loss. These six samples are not a p99 measurement and do not establish a recovery-time SLA. We have not published a 7.3 region-loss latency distribution in this snapshot.

Title: Replication - RivetDB 7.3 Documentation
URL: https://docs.rivetdb.example/7.3/replication
Content: RivetDB 7.3 acknowledgement requires a quorum of two out of three replicas within the primary region. Cross-region replicas apply the log asynchronously; remote_apply_lag_ms reports observed lag and is not a maximum-lag bound or contractual RPO. The synchronous cross-region mode documented for 7.0 was removed in 7.3. This release makes no documented zero-loss guarantee for loss of the entire primary region and publishes no contractual region-loss recovery-time guarantee.
